It changes no existing settings or transport flow.

Output is detached, **not frozen or immutable**. Future admission consumers must separately capture/freeze requests and enforce sender/grant, current epoch and conflict checks. Direct descriptor/accessor/Proxy tests do not establish Electron IPC reachability. No IPC/admission, persistence, emergency/recovery, name convergence, mixed-version transport, runtime readiness, live or release acceptance is claimed. Hosted CI on this exact PR head remains required.
